text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament ends first session of fourth legislative year with satisfying results after the adoption of laws on trade, tourism and administration.
- National Electricity Office (ONE) says there will be no tariff increase in 1997 but reliance on rains make its performance uncertain.
- Taxi drivers strike leads to overcrowded buses.
- Interior ministry says 19 people drowned in a bus after it plunged into river in central Morocco.
- Pharmacists worried about their future ahead of the discussion in parliament of a liberalisation law.
- Three illegal immigrants die and seven are reported missing after boat carrying them capsized in Strait of Gibraltar.
